title.text: Churn fell across the UK while productivity barely moved after the financial crisis
subtitle: Reallocation rate against GVA per hour by ITL2 region, pooled over each period. Dot size = employment; dashed line = linear fit.
Real GVA per hour in 2022 prices (ONS chained-volume measures). Correlations (r) are within each period. Northern Ireland excluded in 2004–08 and from 2011 in 2009–13.
Sources: ONS Longitudinal Business Database (Secure Access, SN 9501); ONS Subregional productivity (June 2025); authors' calculations.
